text: The Hugging Face Hub held about 3.01M public model repositories on 2026-08-22 (aggregator citing a community compilation of Hub API counts); the aggregator reports GGUF-library repos grew 464% in 2026 per HF's State of Open Models: Summer 2026. Count is a secondary figure, not a Hub-published total. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-22)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: `ollama run deepseek-r1` resolves to the 8B distilled DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B (5.2GB), not the 671B model (404GB, separate tag). Ollama's page does not state the default quantization. Critics call the family name misleading; Ollama's page does label the sizes. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: Hub pulls through Ollama are copied into Ollama's hashed blob store, so the same GGUF file cannot be shared directly with other llama.cpp-based tools (critic's claim, not independently verified). (low confidence)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: Hub-sourced quality varies by publisher; docs name community quantizers such as bartowski and MaziyarPanahi as sources, so users should check the publisher and quant rather than trust the repo name. (low confidence)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: Ollama can run any public (and, with an Ollama SSH key added to the Hub account, private) GGUF from the Hugging Face Hub using `ollama run hf.co/{username}/{repository}`; `huggingface.co` works as the domain too. (medium confidence)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: A quantization is selected by appending a tag (`:Q8_0`, `:IQ3_M`, case-insensitive, or a full filename). With no tag, Ollama uses Q4_K_M if present in the repo, otherwise one reasonable quant from the repo. (low confidence)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: For Hub pulls, Ollama picks a chat template from the GGUF's `tokenizer.chat_template` metadata. A repo can override with files named `template` (Go template, not Jinja), `system`, and `params` (JSON). (medium confidence)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: The Ollama library at ollama.com/library lists roughly 240-250 model families with sort by Popular or Newest, pull counts, capability tags and last-updated times; the page shows no per-model publisher field and no mention of community uploads. A Sept 2026 third-party pull counted 239 models and 7,359 tags (about 31 tags per model). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-05)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: Ollama library tags are variants (quantization, size, context) of one family, and the default tag usually maps to an unstated Q4_K_M quantization, so a bare `ollama run <name>` does not tell you the precision. (medium confidence)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub

text: Ollama's registry typically offers only a few quants (commonly Q4_K_M and Q8_0), and Ollama's own quantize supports only Q4_K_S, Q4_K_M, Q8_0, F16, F32 per issues cited by a critic; Hub repos expose the full llama.cpp quant range (e.g. IQ3_M) via the `:quant` tag. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-18)
keywords: Open-weight model catalogs: Ollama library versus Hugging Face Hub
